scopeBasis.macos: Foliole 0.7.7 changes shared desktop editing, review, backup, appearance, localization, and Sync Group behavior, so the supported macOS package is required.
scopeBasis.windows: Foliole 0.7.7 changes shared desktop editing, review, backup, appearance, localization, and Sync Group behavior, including Windows discovery and acceptance fixes, so the supported Windows package is required.
scopeBasis.linux: Foliole 0.7.7 changes the shared desktop renderer, persistence, localization, and Sync Group behavior consumed by Linux Experimental, so its package is required.
